---
title: "Download ADapt"
---

ADapt 0.1.0, the version described in our paper, is on GitHub:
[github.com/sannerlab/adapt](https://github.com/sannerlab/adapt). It runs on **Linux**, in the
Python environment of [ADCP 1.1](../adcp/1.1/download.qmd), with ADFR 0.0.23 and MolKit2 0.0.6.

## 1. Install ADCP 1.1

Follow the [ADCP 1.1 download page](../adcp/1.1/download.qmd). It creates the `adcpsuite`
environment.

## 2. Add ADFR 0.0.23 and MolKit2 0.0.6

They carry the corrections ADapt relies on, and ADCP 1.1 keeps working with them:

```bash
micromamba activate adcpsuite        # or: conda activate adcpsuite
python -m pip install --no-deps --index-url https://sannerlab.github.io/pip/py37/ adfr==0.0.23 molkit2==0.0.6
```

## 3. Get ADapt

```bash
git clone https://github.com/sannerlab/adapt.git
adapt/bin/adapt check                # "ADapt is ready"
adapt/bin/adapt serve --open         # starts ADapt and opens it in your browser
```

`adapt/bin/adapt launcher --desktop` adds an ADapt icon to the applications menu and the desktop.
On a remote machine, run `adapt/bin/adapt serve`, forward its port
(`ssh -L 8766:127.0.0.1:8766 <host>`) and open the printed address. The
[documentation](documentation.qmd) has the details.
